passages.S10.title: S10 · Igbo funeral, member of the umuada
passages.S10.context: She is 52, from Owerri, a daughter of the family. The umuada group has been assigned a black and white George wrapper fabric for the burial. The ground at the village compound is dusty.
passages.S10-A: The assigned black and white George wrapper, a black lace blouse, a matching head tie, flat shoes.
